Structured data format with labeled fields ("Scene:", "Action:", "Dialogue:") establishes a pattern of concise, parallel entries for a fictional training example.

The phrase "Record complete." signals a closing delimiter, suggesting the model is wrapping up a simulated prompt or instruction block, likely followed by a task instruction or response request.

"Record complete." is the final token of a mock training log entry ("Recorded in Chinese style: ... Scene... Action... Dialogue... Record complete."), strongly constraining next tokens to be a new prompt, command, or system message continuing the fictional "recording" interface.
"Recorded a brief story: [content]. Record complete." — the closing phrase "Record complete." ends the block, suggesting a natural boundary or transition marker like "End" or a new instruction follows.
"Training record delivered. Record complete."</explanation>
